object.name: evi_svfsmooth
object.digest: Nonlinear TPT SVF filter with audio rate modulation and morphing capabilities
object.description: A cheap nonlinear 12dB multimode SVF for when you need a quick cheap synth filter. Morphing is between LP..BP..HP filters and is basic output-mixing with resonance attenuation, available at the far left outlet (1). All filters are also available individually via their multimode outlets 2, 3, 4 and 5 (lowpass, bandpass, highpass, notch).

inlets.name: freq
inlets.digestauto: in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on 'cutoffmode' attribute
inlets.digest: Cutoff frequency in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.

inlets.name: morph
inlets.digest: Smoothly interpolate 0..1 between lowpass..bandpass..highpass, available at the far left outlet 1.

attributes.name: cutoffmode
attributes.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (default on) or Hz (off).

attributes.name: morphsmooth
attributes.description: If morphsmooth > 0, the 'Morph' control (inlet 4) will be internally smoothed by this time.

attributes.name: saturation
attributes.description: Internal integrator saturation in dB. Setting this too high will actually dull the filter. Best left at default +20 in most scenarios.

attributes.name: saturationsmooth
attributes.description: If saturationsmooth > 0, the @saturation attribute will be internally smoothed by this time. Default off.
